## Lead Care With Light**®**

## Helping Patients & Families

Acadia Healthcare’s network of mental health and addiction treatment facilities provides premier
care for patients of all ages and genders. We offer every level of care, including acute inpatient
hospitals, residential treatment centers, specialty programs, a variety of outpatient treatment
options, and medication-assisted opioid treatment clinics. Whatever your or your loved one’s needs
may be, we can help.

[ What We Treat][81] [Who We Treat][82] [What Makes Us Different][83]

## Valuing Staff & Culture

Acadia Healthcare’s team consists of devoted professionals who possess a wealth of knowledge in
various disciplines within the behavioral health field. Regardless of the level of care in which you
or your loved one receives treatment, you will benefit from research-based interventions that are
delivered by highly qualified, skilled, and compassionate clinicians.

[Our Culture][84]

## Building Collaboration & Opportunity

Acadia Healthcare prides itself on being a thought leader in the behavioral healthcare industry.
With a focus on innovating the way that mental health and addiction treatment is implemented, we
stay ahead of other behavioral healthcare companies by remaining up to date with evolving research,
delivering superior care in state-of-the-art settings, and ultimately setting the standard for
excellence in the treatment of psychiatric and addiction concerns.

[Professional Referent & Facility Collaboration][85] [Recruiting][86]

## Connecting People & Communities

At Acadia Healthcare, we believe that having a positive impact on the industry goes beyond providing

quality care. By providing education and promoting awareness, we are also able to help in reducing

## Investing Resources & Updates

Acadia Healthcare is a publicly traded company that continues to increase its reach through the

## Committed to Quality

Our mission at Acadia Healthcare is to provide compassionate care that improves lives, inspires
hope, and elevates communities. We set the standard for excellence in the care we provide for those
in need of behavioral health and addiction treatment services. We deliver superior, evidence-based
care with an unparalleled commitment to our patients, our staff, the communities we serve, and the
professionals with whom we partner.

[Learn more about Acadia's unwavering commitment to quality.][90]
Seven Acadia Facilities in Five States ranked in Newsweek's list of America's Best Addiction
Treatment Centers for 2023!

## Our Comprehensive Treatment Network

### ~25,000 Employees · ~12,500 Beds · 277 Locations · 40 States · 1 Network

As a leading provider of behavioral healthcare services in the United States and Puerto Rico, Acadia
Healthcare operates 277 treatment facilities across 40 states. Our network of treatment facilities
offers multiple levels of care for various behavioral health and substance use disorders. At Acadia,
our primary goal is to meet patients where they’re at in their treatment process. We do this by
providing a multitude of levels of care, including detoxification, residential treatment for
addiction, residential treatment for dual diagnosis, acute psychiatric inpatient hospitalization,
medication-assisted treatment (MAT) services, and an array of outpatient programming options,
ranging from partial hospitalization programs (PHPs) and intensive outpatient programs (IOPs) to
traditional outpatient services. Our expansive network of treatment facilities creates greater
access to care, reduces the stigma associated with mental illness and addiction, and offers those in
our communities a safe environment in which to receive the treatment they need.

quality care. By providing education and promoting awareness, we are also able to help in reducing
the stigma that surrounds behavioral health treatment.

[News Coverage & Events][87]

## Investing Resources & Updates

Acadia Healthcare is a publicly traded company that continues to increase its reach through the
construction of new treatment facilities, the expansion of currently owned facilities, the
acquisition of existing facilities, and the development of partnerships with reputable organizations
through joint ventures. Our high working capital appeals to investors, as it demonstrates our
ongoing potential for growth.

NASDAQ ACHC $34.92+0.91 (+2.68%)

[Press Releases][88] [Board of Directors][89]

## Committed to Quality

Our mission at Acadia Healthcare is to provide compassionate care that improves lives, inspires
hope, and elevates communities. We set the standard for excellence in the care we provide for those
in need of behavioral health and addiction treatment services. We deliver superior, evidence-based
care with an unparalleled commitment to our patients, our staff, the communities we serve, and the
professionals with whom we partner.

[Learn more about Acadia's unwavering commitment to quality.][90]
Seven Acadia Facilities in Five States ranked in Newsweek's list of America's Best Addiction
Treatment Centers for 2023!

Our National Affiliations & Organizations

* [[The Joint Commission (JCAHO) Gold Seal of Approval]][97]

## Our Comprehensive Treatment Network

### ~25,000 Employees · ~12,500 Beds · 277 Locations · 40 States · 1 Network

As a leading provider of behavioral healthcare services in the United States and Puerto Rico, Acadia
Healthcare operates 277 treatment facilities across 40 states. Our network of treatment facilities
offers multiple levels of care for various behavioral health and substance use disorders. At Acadia,
our primary goal is to meet patients where they’re at in their treatment process. We do this by
providing a multitude of levels of care, including detoxification, residential treatment for
addiction, residential treatment for dual diagnosis, acute psychiatric inpatient hospitalization,
medication-assisted treatment (MAT) services, and an array of outpatient programming options,
ranging from partial hospitalization programs (PHPs) and intensive outpatient programs (IOPs) to
traditional outpatient services. Our expansive network of treatment facilities creates greater
access to care, reduces the stigma associated with mental illness and addiction, and offers those in
our communities a safe environment in which to receive the treatment they need.

  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?

  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.

  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.

Immersive treatment programs designed for sustainable sobriety

70

## Years of Results

Caron’s been setting standards and delivering real evidence-based treatment since 1957

90%

## of Patients

rated their quality of life as good to very good a year after treatment at Caron

## Programs

Comprehensive care for substance use and co-occurring mental health, offering personalized treatment
and lasting recovery solutions.

[A therapist listens attentively and takes notes while a woman speaks during a counseling session in
a comfortable office setting.]

### Inpatient treatment

Patients live at the treatment facility with a structured environment and 24/7 support.
[ Learn more about Inpatient treatment ][100]
[Outpatient Homepage]

### Outpatient Treatment

Allows patients to receive treatment and support while living at home.
[ Learn more about Outpatient Treatment ][101]
[Family Services]

### Family programs

Dedicated resources for families before, during and after treatment.
[ Learn more about Family programs ][102]
[Resources and Support]

### Resources & Support

Individualized services for you and your loved one to successfully transition back to everyday life.
[ Learn More about Resources & Support ][103]

## Insurance

Caron has negotiated in-network contracts with several insurance providers for both inpatient and
outpatient care.

[ Our insurance options ][104]

### Pennsylvania

Caron’s Pennsylvania campus provides inpatient addiction and behavioral health treatment for
individuals 16+ with specialized programs for LGBTAIQ+, Healthcare Professionals, executives and
more.
[ See Pennsylvania ][105]

[3 FL lobby]
[4 FL patient room]
[5 FL auditorium]

[7 FL pool]

### Florida

Caron’s Florida campus provides inpatient and outpatient treatment for addiction and behavioral
health for individuals 18+ with specialized programs for affluent adults, Neurocognitive Assessments
and professionals.
[ See Florida ][106]

## Ginny

"Without Caron, my life would look very different. It would not be full of promise, and hope, and
purpose, and honesty. And love."

## Steve

I didn’t know ‘how’ to get well. And that’s what Caron did for me. They work the whole body. Caron
transformed me into a well, healthy here [mind] and here [body] person.

## Louis and Stephanie

That was like the biggest moment for me at Caron. Because I’m allowed to have feelings and I’m
allowed to get upset and I’m allowed to feel like I matter in all of this. And not get in trouble
for it.
[Icon of a heart inside of a shield.]

## See what others are saying

Read our reviews today!
[ Read reviews ][107]

## Community

Caron offers virtual and in-person recovery services to complement the work you did in treatment and
navigate early recovery.

[Pexels yankrukov 8199596]

### Recovery Services

Services are offered virtually and include My Recovery Connection.
[ Learn more about Recovery Services about Recovery Services ][108]
[Alumni Community]

### Alumni Community

Caron’s Alumni Community is a welcoming network of alumni who share their experiences, offer
support, and celebrate life in recovery together.
[ Learn more and Alumni Community about Alumni Community ][109]
[Renaissance interior therapy group sitting]

### Parent and Family Support Groups

Groups to support loved ones of individuals with substance use disorder and to provide a safe place
to find education and hope.
[ Learn more about support groups about Parent and Family Support Groups ][110]
[Breakthrough at Caron]

### Breakthrough at Caron

Caron’s Breakthrough Program offers transformative workshops for individuals, couples, and others.
[ Learn more about Breakthrough about Breakthrough at Caron ][111]

[ View all events ][112]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

[Patient at the Heart]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

### [ Pharmaceutical & Medical Supplies Distribution Services ][127]

[Pharmacist in a white coat holding a prescription bottle in a pharmacy, with shelves of medications
and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

[ Read More ][133]
News & Stories

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

## Building a Healthier, Stronger Future With MultiCare

Plans are underway for Samaritan Health Services to affiliate with MultiCare Health System, a highly
respected, mission-driven organization based out of Tacoma, Washington. Completion is anticipated by
spring or summer of 2026.

[Learn More About the Affiliation][161]

Samaritan Health Services offers trusted specialty care — from [cancer][162], [heart][163] and

# Welcome to Access Behavioral Health

Since 2001, Access Behavioral Health (ABH) has managed the mental health and substance use services
for Medicaid recipients and residents of northwest Florida. We have created a network of providers
who focus on the core principles of recovery: strengths-based, person-centered, individualized
treatment and support for people with mental illness and substance use disorders. Through
contracting, monitoring, network management, and quality improvement efforts, we have improved the
coordination, integration, and management of service delivery to those with emotional, mental, or
addictive disorders.

### Individualized treatment and support for people with mental illness and substance use disorders

ABH has developed a comprehensive, community-based system of care by contracting with experienced
providers offering evidence-based services. We contract with a wide variety of behavioral health
care providers to respect and ensure consumer choice and to meet the special health care needs of
our Medicaid members. Guided by our mission of “helping people,” our specialized team strives to
meet the behavioral health needs of those we serve.

[Silhouette profile of woman with artistic rendering if light coming from inside her mind]

### Community-based system of care for Medicaid recipients and Northwest Florida residents

# Welcome to Access Behavioral Health

Since 2001, Access Behavioral Health (ABH) has managed the mental health and substance use services
for Medicaid recipients and residents of northwest Florida. We have created a network of providers
who focus on the core principles of recovery: strengths-based, person-centered, individualized
treatment and support for people with mental illness and substance use disorders. Through
contracting, monitoring, network management, and quality improvement efforts, we have improved the
coordination, integration, and management of service delivery to those with emotional, mental, or
addictive disorders.

### Individualized treatment and support for people with mental illness and substance use disorders

ABH has developed a comprehensive, community-based system of care by contracting with experienced
providers offering evidence-based services. We contract with a wide variety of behavioral health
care providers to respect and ensure consumer choice and to meet the special health care needs of
our Medicaid members. Guided by our mission of “helping people,” our specialized team strives to
meet the behavioral health needs of those we serve.

## The Allied BHI Difference

### Why Choose Our Collaborative Care Model?

The importance of affordable and excellent psychiatric services for patients is widely recognized.
By partnering with Allied BHI, you demonstrate a commitment to prioritizing your patients’ mental
health. Our collaborative care model seamlessly integrates behavioral health services into your
practice, resulting in improved patient outcomes and overall efficiency. Once you experience the
benefits, you’ll wonder why you didn’t join us sooner.

#### **Accessible &**
#### **Affordable**

[Accessible and affordable icon logo][Accessible and affordable icon logo]

We eliminate the problem of where to receive expert care by making our behavioral health specialists
available to your patients as soon as they need them.

#### **Customized,**
#### **Integrated Care**

[Integrated care icon][Integrated care icon]

By integrating mental health and primary care services, patients are able to receive convenient care
in one place while providers benefit from collaborative treatment planning.

#### **Innovative**
#### **Solutions**

[Innovative solution graphic logo icon][Innovative solution graphic logo icon]

Our innovative model of mental healthcare and our groundbreaking software helps to seamlessly
integrate mental health services into your practice.

#### **Efficient**
#### **Outcomes**

[Efficient outcomes icon black gray][Efficient outcomes icon black gray]

##  What Is Behavioral Health Integration?

### Mental Health Services All Under One Roof

Behavioral health integration combines physical and mental healthcare services within one healthcare
setting to address the interconnection between a patient’s physical and mental health. Traditionally
treated separately, physical and mental health are actually interconnected, with one in three people
having both conditions. Integration promotes a holistic approach, incorporating mental health
services into healthcare settings. This simultaneous treatment of physical and psychological health
leads to increased revenue for providers and improved patient access to care.

Why Ascot Rehab

## Specialist rehabilitation, planned around the person — not just the condition.

We bring together consultant oversight, experienced therapists, nursing support and rehabilitation
technology in one coordinated plan. From the first assessment, our focus is to help each patient
move forward safely, confidently and with clear goals.

Consultant-led care

### Clear clinical guidance from the beginning.

Every rehabilitation pathway is supported by specialist clinical input, helping patients and
families understand the plan, the goals and the next steps.

#### One coordinated team

Physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech and language therapy, neuropsychology, nursing and
medical teams work together around shared goals.

#### Technology with purpose

Rehabilitation technology is used where it can support repetition, movement, confidence and
measurable progress.

#### Goals that matter in real life

We shape rehabilitation around independence, mobility, communication, confidence, family life and
quality of life.

Therapy Disciplines

## Specialist therapy, explained clearly and delivered as one team.

Rehabilitation can involve several different specialists. At Ascot Rehab, each discipline works
together around one shared plan, so patients and families understand who is involved, what each
therapy is helping with, and how progress is being reviewed.

# Association for Cognitive and Behavioral Psychotherapy

since 1999
WELCOME
St Petersburg is looking forward to host the IACBT-C 2024 as we believe it will significantly
contribute to the development of cognitive behavioral therapy in our region, as well as throughout
the Russian Federation and in the post-Soviet area.

IACBT-C is an outstanding event in the world of professionals in the field of mental health and
socionomics, a great source for improving skills and gaining new modern knowledge for cognitive
behavioral therapy and psychotherapy in general, a powerful impetus to professional growth and
personal fulfillment.

Respectfully yours,
**Dmitrii Kovpak**
**President of the Association**
**For Cognitive Behavioral Psychotherapy of Russia**
**Dear colleagues! We are proud to inform you about EABCT Congress 2024!**

This years EABCT Congress is taking place in the vibrant city of Belgrade, Serbia, from September
4-7, with the theme, "New Age of CBT - Challenges and Perspectives."
This is an opportunity to:
• Engage with world-renowned speakers and CBT practitioners (registration is open!)
• Share your research and insights (call for abstracts is open!)
• Network with peers
• Experience the rich culture and hospitality of Belgrade.

Your participation will not only contribute to the advancement of CBT but also offer you an
unforgettable experience in one of Europe's most captivating and vibrant cities.

Registration is available on [eabct2024.org][1]

See you in Belgrade!
Association of Cognitive and Behavioral Psychotherapy (Russia) Founded in 1999 We bring together
mental health professionals with the mission to promote cognitive and behavioral therapy in Russian
Federation as well as provide highly professional help and support for our patients and clients.

**Address**
197374 St. Petersburg, 62 Primorsky Ave., building 1, office 51-N Russia
**Phone: **+7(911)9224419

[www.associationcbt.ru][2]


We are the only organization which has State Educational License and legally provide CBT training
with local analog of CE for mental health professionals.
Every year RACBP publishes a few professional journals registered with ISBN and in Russian science
citation index.
Our association
25 regional branches in Russia - our members include over 1000 clinical professional - over 3000
clinicians participated in our educational programs

# Homepage

DABATEM *(**Istanbul Center for Behavioral Sciences*** – formerly the *Istanbul Center for Behavior
Research and Therapy*) is an independent research center internationally recognized for its
pioneering research into mental health effects of wars, torture, and earthquakes, and their
effective treatment. It has been founded and is currently directed by [Professor Metin Başoğlu][56].

Mass trauma events affect large numbers of people and lead to a serious mental health problem around
the world. Effective dealing with this problem requires a mental healthcare model based on
interventions that are (1) theoretically sound, (2) proven to be effective, (3) brief, (4) easy to
train therapists in their delivery, (5) practicable in different cultures, and (6) suitable for
dissemination through media other than professional therapists, such as lay people, self-help tools,
and mass media. Current trauma treatments do not meet more than two or three of these requirements.

DABATEM has conducted extensive research over 40 years with trauma survivors to develop a
psychological treatment ([Control-Focused Behavioral Treatment – CFBT][57]), which meets all of the
above requirements. CFBT is a brief intervention that reduces traumatic stress by enhancing** sense
of control** over (or resilience against) trauma.  [Available evidence][58] suggests that it
achieves greater improvement than other evidence-based treatments.

DABATEM has also developed a [mental healthcare model][59] for earthquake survivors that
incorporates various brief and innovative applications of CFBT and treatment delivery strategies
that enable cost-effective dissemination of care to large survivor populations. Work is in progress
to develop a similar model for survivors of war and torture. A recent [treatment study][60] has
shown that CFBT is highly effective in survivors of war and torture.

# Приводим в порядок
# расстроенную психику

С нами вы обретете стойкую ремиссию, научитесь жить с расстройством психики и улучшите качество
жизни.

### Клиника на Парке культуры

Коробейников переулок, 22, стр.3
10:00 до 22:00 (без выходных)

### Клиника на Красных воротах

•       м. Красные ворота
Фурманный переулок, 9/12
10:00 до 22:00 (без выходных)

Лицензия: ЛО41-01137-77/00342332
Лицензия: Л041-01137-77/05533567

  от 10 лет
* Интегративный
  подход

  отзывов
* Уютная домашняя
  атмосфера
* Гарантия
  конфиденциальности

## С чем к нам чаще всего обращаются

Я постоянно беспокоюсь, у меня **тревога**, **страхи**, **приступы паники**, я во всем сомневаюсь
и всего боюсь.

Я не могу заставить себя начать заниматься делами, **постоянно все откладываю**, не могу
yсконцентрироваться.

У меня **проблемы со сном**: я не могу уснуть, сон чуткий, я не могу выспаться, чувствую себя сонным
днем.

У меня сердцебиение, разные боли **неприятные ощущения ** **в теле** каждый раз, как я понервничаю
или разозлюсь.

У меня **плохое настроение**,
апатия, ни от чего не получаю
удовольствия, нет интересов.

У меня постоянно напряжение,
меня **все раздражает**,** злит**,
бесит, я не могу никого видеть.

У меня **проблемы **
**в сексуальной жизни**, пропало
желание, совсем нет влечения.

Я **постоянно уставший**, совсем
нет сил, не могу расслабиться,
отдохнуть, восстановиться.

Мы помогаем с любыми психиатрическими и психосоматическими расстройствами — от первых тревожных
звоночков до сложных состояний.

Приходите один, с партнёром или всей семьёй.

[Learn More][150] * Exhibition | *13* April 2026 [CMEF 2026 On-site Report | Getein Empowers the Diagnostic World][151] CMEF 2026 On-site Report | Getein Empowers the Diagnostic World      The 2026 China International Medical Equipment Fair (CMEF) is underway at the National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai). Since opening day, Getein's booth (Booth No. 7.1P27) has been drawing significant crowds, establishing itself as one of the most talked-about exhibits in the diagnostic hall. Booth Highlights The Getein team is warmly welcoming partners from China and overseas to visit our booth. In-depth discussions, ranging from precision diagnostic needs to total solution planning, are making the path to future cooperation increasingly clear.     As a key platform connecting the global medical device market, this year's CMEF (April 9–12 2026) brings together industry elites from around the world. Getein's booth with its innovative diagnostic concepts and cutting-edge technology displays is attracting a steady stream of professional visitors.     Spotlight At the exhibition, Getein's innovative products successfully drew lots of partners and industry professionals from home and abroad. The diagnostic solution comprehensively covers POCT, chemiluminescence, clinical chemistry, modular systems, hematology, coagulation, molecular diagnostics, veterinary diagnostics and rehabilitation products. It jointly builds a full-scenario and intelligent diagnostic ecosystem from fast point-of-care tests to high-throughput laboratory solutions.     Event Information ·Event Name: 2026 China International Medical Equipment Fair (CMEF) ·Date: April 9–12, 2026 ·Venue: National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai) ·Getein Booth No.: 7.1P27     Looking Ahead The exhibition is in full swing. Getein sincerely invites more industry colleagues and partners to visit Booth 7.1P27 and experience the innovative appeal of our smart lab solutions firsthand. We look forward to meeting, talking, and co-creating with even more friends during the remaining days of the show.           [[CMEF 2026 On-site Report | Getein Empowers the Diagnostic World]][152] * Exhibition | *26* March 2026 [Fully Self-developed Lineup Shines in Xiamen, Promotions Ignite CACLP 2026][153] Fully Self-developed Lineup Shines in Xiamen, Promotions Ignite CACLP 2026 The 23rd CACLP officially kicks off today in Xiamen. Making a powerful statement with the theme "Fully Self-developed, One-stop Solution", Getein Biotech unveils its star-studded product lineup, showcasing a complete ecosystem ranging from POCT to fully automated laboratory lines. Getein's booth consistently pulls in a steady stream of visitors.   The Center of Attention As Getein Biotech's newest innovation in laboratory automation, the Metis 7000 has built a strong industry reputation for its highly integrated design, reliable performance, and intelligent workflow management. Metis 7000 is also drawing considerable crowds at the exhibition, with many attendees stopping by for a closer look.     The first day of CACLP is off to an extraordinary start for Getein. Our booth has become a true hub of international energy, welcoming distributors from across the globe. With every handshake and meaningful conversation, we are witnessing something truly special: a powerful vote of confidence in our products. These partners are not just exploring solutions; they are placing their trust in the Getein brand. Their enthusiasm speaks volumes, reaffirming that our commitment to quality, innovation, and reliable diagnostics resonates deeply on a global scale.     New Product Launch Beyond the standout performance of its star automated line, Getein Biotech's two new products unveiled this time—the CM-480 Benchtop Fully Automated Clinical Chemistry Analyzer and the MAGICL 6800 Fully Automated Chemiluminescence Immunoassay Analyzer—also become focal points of the booth, drawing large crowds of professional visitors to stop and explore.      The Road Ahead     Looking ahead, Getein will remain committed to innovation, deepen its presence in the in-vitro diagnostics field, and launch even more competitive products and services to drive high-quality development in laboratory medicine.     [[Fully Self-developed Lineup Shines in Xiamen, Promotions Ignite CACLP 2026]][154] * Exhibition | *13* February 2026 [Getein Concludes a Successful Journey at WHX Labs Dubai!][155] Getein Concludes a Successful Journey at WHX Labs Dubai!   The Event Concludes, the Future Begins The WHX Labs Dubai exhibition has come to a successful close, marking a journey filled with inspiration and meaningful connections. We extend our heartfelt gratitude to every visitor, partner, and friend who stopped by Booth S1.B50.     Over the past few days, our booth buzzed with vibrant and professional exchanges. We engaged in in-depth and fruitful discussions with industry peers, partners, and friends from the Middle East and around the world, exploring regional challenges and opportunities. Together, we envisioned the future blueprint of precision diagnostics and smart laboratories, with every insightful conversation leaving us enriched and inspired.     Getein’s Booth: A Focal Point in the Middle East As a pivotal hub connecting Eastern and Western laboratory markets, WHX Labs Dubai gathered global industry attention. Getein’s booth, with its innovative diagnostic concepts and cutting-edge technological displays, attracted a steady stream of professional visitors, fostering an atmosphere of continuous engagement and dialogue.     Our team, with professionalism and enthusiasm, warmly welcomed numerous new and existing friends from Gulf Cooperation Council countries, North Africa, South Asia, and Europe.

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

The idea for GetProspect came after talking with a salesperson friend who struggled to find valid

We are building an all-in-one platform that will help businesses to find email addresses and leads,

## About Us

[Company][36]

### Reasons why people choose ITO

Over 100 years since the foundation in 1916, we have been developing numerous physiotherapy
products. Although our top-quality products have been widely acclaimed in Japan and overseas, we are
never satisfied with the current situation. We will continue to improve and develop new products to
create a more age-friendly and healthier society.

We have been exporting our high-quality products for over 30 years more than 100 countries through
our reliable partners in each country. To supply our products worldwide, we are certified for ISO
13485. We have also passed the strict international quality standards and specifications such as CE,
FDA and UL.

## See you in Bangkok

We are excited to meet you at the upcoming Bangkok Exhibition.

During the exhibition, our team will be presenting professional physiotherapy and rehabilitation
solutions, including our latest devices and application ideas for clinics, distributors, and
rehabilitation professionals. We warmly welcome all visitors, partners, and industry friends to
visit our booth, communicate with our team, and explore more cooperation opportunities together.

## New Launch
* **Piezonia,  redefined piezoelectric shockwave**
  
  ✅ High-precision piezoelectric focused shockwave
  ✅ Stable output with consistent energy performance
  ✅ Comfortable treatment with precise focal targeting
  ✅ 7 interchangeable depth pads for flexible adjustment
  ✅ 0-65 mm focal depth coverage
  
  ✅ Up to 5 million shots handpiece lifespan
  ✅ ntelligent programs and a 13.3-inch HD touchscreen for intuitive operation
  ✅ 3 intelligent modes for different treatment rhythms and clinical needs
  ✅ Wide frequency range from 1 to 10 Hz
  ✅ Durable design for long-term clinical use
  
  [ Learn more ][76]

[Piezonia]

Global Innovative Manufacturer of Physical Therapy Equipment

## Who are we？

Kaphaphysio is more than a manufacturer — we are innovators driven by a profound commitment to
physiotherapy. By integrating advanced R&D, dedicated production, and global distribution, we
deliver high-performance rehabilitation and therapy equipment tailored to diverse clinical
requirements.

## Technologies

We integrate the ten most popular technologies in rehabilitation and physical therapy—from shockwave
and laser to TECAR, ultrasound, PEMF, and beyond. Whatever your clinical focus—pain management,
functional recovery, or advanced treatment—we provide trusted, comprehensive solutions.

## Global exhibitions

Our products and technologies have been showcased at leading exhibitions across Europe, Southeast
Asia, the Middle East, and beyond. Through these international platforms, we engage directly with
therapists, distributors, and medical professionals—exchanging insights, exploring trends, and
building partnerships that drive the future of rehabilitation.

## Distributors

We pride ourselves on outstanding service capabilities, offering distributors tailored solutions,
professional training, and strategic marketing planning. With unwavering support from initial
concept to post-delivery and beyond, we are committed to driving your growth and achieving shared
success.

## Our Factory

Kaphaphysio delivers tailored solutions within 72 hours, backed by a 3,000㎡ modern production
facility and an in-house R&D team. We provide comprehensive OEM/ODM services and scalable
manufacturing capabilities to empower global partners with speed, flexibility, and reliability.

## Explore Therapy Technologies & Devices

### Focused Shockwave Therapy

Focused shockwave therapy delivers concentrated acoustic energy into targeted tissue areas, making
it suitable for deep musculoskeletal conditions, chronic pain, tendon injuries, and precise
rehabilitation applications.
[ View Devices ][77] [ Learn Technology ][78]

### Radial Shockwave Therapy

Radial shockwave therapy spreads acoustic energy across a broader treatment area, making it ideal
for superficial pain, muscle tension, myofascial conditions, and sports recovery treatments.
[ View Devices ][79] [ Learn Technology ][80]

### Magneto Therapy

Magneto therapy uses pulsed electromagnetic fields to stimulate deeper tissues, support pain
management, improve recovery, and assist rehabilitation for muscles, joints, tendons, and soft
tissue conditions.
[ View Devices ][81] [ Learn Technology ][82]

### Laser Therapy

Laser therapy delivers therapeutic light energy to support tissue repair, reduce discomfort, improve
circulation, and assist recovery in physical therapy and rehabilitation settings.
[ View Devices ][83] [ Learn Technology ][84]

### Tecar Therapy

TECAR therapy uses capacitive and resistive radiofrequency energy to stimulate deep tissues, improve
circulation, support soft tissue recovery, and enhance rehabilitation efficiency.
[ View Devices ][85] [ Learn Technology ][86]

### Ultrasound Therapy

Ultrasound therapy uses high-frequency sound waves to penetrate soft tissues, support tissue
healing, relieve pain, and improve circulation in clinical physiotherapy applications.
[ View Devices ][87] [ Learn Technology ][88]

## Explore Therapy Technologies & Devices

### Focused Shockwave Therapy

Focused shockwave therapy delivers concentrated acoustic energy into targeted tissue areas, making
it suitable for deep musculoskeletal conditions, chronic pain, tendon injuries, and precise
rehabilitation applications.
[ View Devices ][77] [ Learn Technology ][78]

### Radial Shockwave Therapy

Radial shockwave therapy spreads acoustic energy across a broader treatment area, making it ideal
for superficial pain, muscle tension, myofascial conditions, and sports recovery treatments.
[ View Devices ][79] [ Learn Technology ][80]

### Magneto Therapy

Magneto therapy uses pulsed electromagnetic fields to stimulate deeper tissues, support pain
management, improve recovery, and assist rehabilitation for muscles, joints, tendons, and soft
tissue conditions.
[ View Devices ][81] [ Learn Technology ][82]

### Laser Therapy

Laser therapy delivers therapeutic light energy to support tissue repair, reduce discomfort, improve
circulation, and assist recovery in physical therapy and rehabilitation settings.
[ View Devices ][83] [ Learn Technology ][84]

### Tecar Therapy

TECAR therapy uses capacitive and resistive radiofrequency energy to stimulate deep tissues, improve
circulation, support soft tissue recovery, and enhance rehabilitation efficiency.
[ View Devices ][85] [ Learn Technology ][86]

### Ultrasound Therapy

Ultrasound therapy uses high-frequency sound waves to penetrate soft tissues, support tissue
healing, relieve pain, and improve circulation in clinical physiotherapy applications.
[ View Devices ][87] [ Learn Technology ][88]

## Professionals Network

Explore our network of experienced counselors and therapists to receive personalized care.

### [ Victoria Fahy ][134]

LCSW, SEP • Licensed Clinical Social Worker

Victoria C. Fahy, LCSW, SEP, is a Licensed Clinical Social Worker with 20+ years of experience. She
specializes in trauma, anxiety, depression, and interpersonal issues, using an eclectic approach
including CBT, EFT, and Somatic Experiencing.

### [ Peter Bogdonavic ][135]

MSW, LSW • Licensed Social Worker

Peter Bogdonavic, MSW, LSW, is a virtual therapist specializing in adult mental health. He offers
compassionate, client-centered care for trauma, depression, anxiety, and relationship issues,
believing that change comes from within.

### [ Holly Drummond ][136]

LPC, NCC, TCTSY-F, RYT 500 • Licensed Professional Counselor

Holly Drummond, LPC, NCC, TCTSY-F, RYT 500, offers a holistic approach to therapy, blending
cognitive-behavioral techniques with trauma-sensitive yoga and mindfulness. Specializing in
individual and couples counseling, she creates a safe space for clients to reconnect mind and body,
fostering healing and personal growth.

### [ Silvana Loka ][137]

PhD • Licensed Clinical Psychologist

Dr. Silvana Loka, PhD, is a Licensed Clinical Psychologist at Sejdaras Psy.D & Associates,
specializing in anxiety, depression, and relationship therapy. With 20 years of experience, she
combines DBT, CBT, and mindfulness to help clients discover their true identity and purpose.

### [ Ryan Russ ][138]

LPC • Licensed Professional Counselor

Ryan Russ, LPC, co-founder of The Finding Place Counseling and Recovery, revolutionizes therapy with
custom treatment plans and cutting-edge techniques. Specializing in addiction, trauma, and shame, he
leads a boutique clinic dedicated to effective, individualized care.

### [ DaiDra Thompson ][139]

LPC • Licensed Professional Counselor

DaiDra Thompson, LPC, is a compassionate therapist with 8+ years of experience helping diverse
clients navigate life’s challenges. Specializing in trauma, anxiety, and mood disorders, she uses a
person-centered approach with EMDR, CBT, and DBT techniques to meet each client’s unique needs.

## Professionals Network

Explore our network of experienced counselors and therapists to receive personalized care.

### [ Victoria Fahy ][134]

LCSW, SEP • Licensed Clinical Social Worker

Victoria C. Fahy, LCSW, SEP, is a Licensed Clinical Social Worker with 20+ years of experience. She
specializes in trauma, anxiety, depression, and interpersonal issues, using an eclectic approach
including CBT, EFT, and Somatic Experiencing.

### [ Peter Bogdonavic ][135]

MSW, LSW • Licensed Social Worker

Peter Bogdonavic, MSW, LSW, is a virtual therapist specializing in adult mental health. He offers
compassionate, client-centered care for trauma, depression, anxiety, and relationship issues,
believing that change comes from within.

### [ Holly Drummond ][136]

LPC, NCC, TCTSY-F, RYT 500 • Licensed Professional Counselor

Holly Drummond, LPC, NCC, TCTSY-F, RYT 500, offers a holistic approach to therapy, blending
cognitive-behavioral techniques with trauma-sensitive yoga and mindfulness. Specializing in
individual and couples counseling, she creates a safe space for clients to reconnect mind and body,
fostering healing and personal growth.

### [ Silvana Loka ][137]

PhD • Licensed Clinical Psychologist

Dr. Silvana Loka, PhD, is a Licensed Clinical Psychologist at Sejdaras Psy.D & Associates,
specializing in anxiety, depression, and relationship therapy. With 20 years of experience, she
combines DBT, CBT, and mindfulness to help clients discover their true identity and purpose.

### [ Ryan Russ ][138]

LPC • Licensed Professional Counselor

Ryan Russ, LPC, co-founder of The Finding Place Counseling and Recovery, revolutionizes therapy with
custom treatment plans and cutting-edge techniques. Specializing in addiction, trauma, and shame, he
leads a boutique clinic dedicated to effective, individualized care.

### [ DaiDra Thompson ][139]

LPC • Licensed Professional Counselor

DaiDra Thompson, LPC, is a compassionate therapist with 8+ years of experience helping diverse
clients navigate life’s challenges. Specializing in trauma, anxiety, and mood disorders, she uses a
person-centered approach with EMDR, CBT, and DBT techniques to meet each client’s unique needs.

disease that can occur with underdeveloped lungs. Today, Levi is a smiley, joyful two-year old who’s
reaching milestones and getting stronger every day.

# We exist to improve children’s behavioral health across
# our region.

The New England Children’s Behavioral Health Network has a vision of a system of care that is
preventive, upstream, collaborative, accessible, equitable and family-centered. Through our advocacy
and network-building we work to improve children’s behavioral health across the region.

[ About Us ][42]

# Preventative

# Collaborative

# Accessible

# Equitable

# Family-centered

# Preventative Collaborative Accessible Equitable Family-centered

**ABOUT US**

## Children’s behavioral health is our priority.

We know that the fragmentation of children’s behavioral health care is not unique to one state. The
Network’s collaborative, regional approach allows us to bring together stakeholders to learn and
pool resources. Our stakeholders are currently located across Rhode Island, Connecticut and
Massachusetts.

[ View Our Mission ][43]
[Children playing and laughing outdoors in a park-like setting on a sunny day.]
[Light blue abstract brushstroke pattern on black background.]

## We focus on three key areas needed to drive change:

[Illustration of a handshake with a yellow background.]

### Family and
### Community Assets

[A lighthouse with a heart, showing a beacon of hope.]

### Access and The
### Continuum of Care

[Outlines of two heads, with a lightbulb containing a heart between them, showing collaboration and
innovation.]

### Behavioral
### Health Workforce

[ Our Focuses ][44]

### Recent Publications:

Featured
[
][45]
April 11, 2025
[ Whitepaper - Thinking Beyond The Funding Cliff: Sustaining Children’s Behavioral Health Services
][46]
April 11, 2025
April 11, 2025

**REGIONAL COLLABORATION**

## We envision a different system for children’s behavioral health.

By bringing together health care providers, payers, schools, community organizations and policy
makers, we can change the system.  We want to ensure that children and families receive preventive
care and support in their communities, and to move away from our current, crisis-driven system.

[ Get Involved ][47]

hanging in the background.]

We work to increase access to youth mental health care and provide mental health advocacy for

## Who We Are

Welcome to **Psychowellness Center**, Delhi’s premier mental health clinic chain led by chief
practitioner **[Dr(Prof) R. K. Suri][35]****.** With  42+ years of clinical excellence, Dr. Suri
specializes in evidence-based therapy for [anxiety][36], [depression][37], [OCD][38],
[addiction][39], phobia,  [relationship issues][40],  marriage counselling, life coaching and child
behavioral disorders. Serving patients across **Janakpuri, Dwarka,  Gurugram, Vasant Vihar, Anand
Niketan, Vasantkunj** and **Paschim Vihar**, Psychowellness Center offers a safe, confidential space
for holistic psychological healing.

**Book an appointment with Dr. Suri today for trusted mental healthcare near you.**

**Psychowellness Center’s** multidisciplinary team also includes **[Psychologists,][41]
[Therapists][42], [Psychiatrists][43], [Pediatricians][44], **and **[Special educators][45]** who
work together to deliver holistic, evidence-based care. We offer therapies such as **[Cognitive
Behavioral Therapy][46] ([CBT][47]), [Dialectical Behavior Therapy][48] ([DBT][49]), [Acceptance and
commitment therapy][50] ([ABA)][51], [Expressive Arts Therapy][52], **and[** Occupational
Therapy**][53]. With a client-centered approach, we aim to promote emotional well-being and personal
growth.

Start your journey today with our **free** [**Online Self-Assessments**][54] for all age groups.

### Sierra Tucson

## Providing Exceptional Drug & Alcohol Addiction & Behavioral Health Treatment

## Find Your Path at Sierra Tucson

Since 1984, the caring and skilled staff at Sierra Tucson has been dedicated to providing clinical
excellence and compassionate, effective treatment for all who are entrusted into our care.
Recommended by doctors and therapists across the world, we are recognized for providing safe and
successful treatment for those who are struggling with addiction and a wide range of complex
behavioral health disorders. Our renowned programs have resulted in positive change in the lives of
over 34,000 residents and more than 90,000 family members.

We are here to help you through this difficult time. It takes courage to seek treatment, and we are
committed to helping you through this process.

With extensive training and decades of experience, Sierra Tucson maintains a high standard of
excellence in the clinical treatment programs that we offer for individuals aged 18 and older, who
are struggling with [drug & alcohol
addiction][148], [depression][149], [anxiety][150], [trauma][151], and [co-occurring
disorders][152]. By utilizing a multidisciplinary approach, we help you learn how to successfully
manage symptoms, overcome challenges, and develop the skills needed to manage your disease and
return to your family, friends, and a productive lifestyle.

Please call us today to speak with a knowledgeable staff member who can answer your questions, guide
you in the direction that will be most beneficial in meeting your needs, and assist you in getting
started on the road toward overall wellness. Your new journey will soon begin at the nation’s
leading addiction and mental health treatment center, Sierra Tucson.

## The Sierra Tucson Model®

The Sierra Tucson Model integrates philosophies and practices from the medical, psychological,
family systems, and self-help communities. The 12-Step Program and other addiction support group
options enhance intensive psychiatric care. The result is a powerful treatment experience.

Every program we offer is shaped by the philosophy of our model. Because it is designed to treat the
whole person, residents learn to understand the underlying causes of emotional and behavioral
disorders and recognize how to manage their disease throughout their lifetime. This prepares them
for the challenge of staying healthy once treatment ends.

### Sierra Tucson

## Providing Exceptional Drug & Alcohol Addiction & Behavioral Health Treatment

## Find Your Path at Sierra Tucson

Since 1984, the caring and skilled staff at Sierra Tucson has been dedicated to providing clinical
excellence and compassionate, effective treatment for all who are entrusted into our care.
Recommended by doctors and therapists across the world, we are recognized for providing safe and
successful treatment for those who are struggling with addiction and a wide range of complex
behavioral health disorders. Our renowned programs have resulted in positive change in the lives of
over 34,000 residents and more than 90,000 family members.

We are here to help you through this difficult time. It takes courage to seek treatment, and we are
committed to helping you through this process.

With extensive training and decades of experience, Sierra Tucson maintains a high standard of
excellence in the clinical treatment programs that we offer for individuals aged 18 and older, who
are struggling with [drug & alcohol
addiction][148], [depression][149], [anxiety][150], [trauma][151], and [co-occurring
disorders][152]. By utilizing a multidisciplinary approach, we help you learn how to successfully
manage symptoms, overcome challenges, and develop the skills needed to manage your disease and
return to your family, friends, and a productive lifestyle.

Please call us today to speak with a knowledgeable staff member who can answer your questions, guide
you in the direction that will be most beneficial in meeting your needs, and assist you in getting
started on the road toward overall wellness. Your new journey will soon begin at the nation’s
leading addiction and mental health treatment center, Sierra Tucson.

## The Sierra Tucson Model®

The Sierra Tucson Model integrates philosophies and practices from the medical, psychological,
family systems, and self-help communities. The 12-Step Program and other addiction support group
options enhance intensive psychiatric care. The result is a powerful treatment experience.

Every program we offer is shaped by the philosophy of our model. Because it is designed to treat the
whole person, residents learn to understand the underlying causes of emotional and behavioral
disorders and recognize how to manage their disease throughout their lifetime. This prepares them
for the challenge of staying healthy once treatment ends.

### A Unified Front Door

## Flexible access to robust condition networks

Solera matches members with the appropriate programs tailored to their specific needs, ensuring
effective management and improvement of their overall health.

### Digestive Health

Solera offers virtual GI treatment, using personalized matching to connect individuals with the
right digestive health program for them.

89% of low acuity members experienced a reduction in GI symptoms.
‍

### Hypertension

Solera offers a personalized digital hypertension management program that integrates advanced
technology and human support.

62.9% of users showed a reduction in systolic blood pressure at one year post enrollment.

### Mental Health

Solera offers a personalized digital mental health management program that integrates advanced
technology and human support.

32% of users reduce stress after 30 days using Headspace.
‍

### Musculoskeletal (MSK)

Solera offers a personalized digital MSK management program that integrates advanced technology and
human support.

71.6% of high acuity users achieved a 30% decrease in pain.
‍

### Tobacco Cessation

Solera offers a personalized digital tobacco cessation program that integrates advanced technology
and human support.

34% of users have quit at nine months using the Ex program.
‍

### Women's Health

Solera matches women to appropriate programs that cater to their unique needs at every stage of
life, providing care across the entire spectrum of women’s health.

Using Origin, women experience an 87% reduction in pelvic pain.

### Weight Management

Solera offers weight management that extends beyond simple diet plans. We have a purpose-built
network that addresses various health needs through evidence-based lifestyle change programs.




### Diabetes Management

Solera's diabetes management provides Dario as the digital solution to address Type 2 Diabetes.

30-40% of Dario users achieve diabetic remission (A1C under 6.5%).


‍

## Guided journey to best-fit solutions

At Solera Health, we empower individuals to achieve their healthiest selves by matching them with
care solutions tailored to their unique needs. Our proprietary clinical algorithms consider
behavioral models, engagement preferences, and clinical qualifications to provide personalized care.
This data-driven, acuity-based approach ensures efficient spending and improved health outcomes,
benefiting both members and organizations.

## Aligned incentives for all stakeholders

Our pay-for-performance pricing methodology means that both Solera and our network partners only do
well if the participant does well. Having all constituents in alignment will ultimately yield the
best results in terms of cost of care and delivering actual member health outcomes.

## Thematic and Disruption Research

Our Thematic & Disruption Research identifies the structural shifts, emerging technologies, new
business models, and macro forces reshaping industries. We decode early signals, model long-term
scenarios, and highlight opportunities and risks-equipping leaders with future-ready insight to
guide strategy, investment, innovation, and organizational resilience.

Deep dives on cross-cutting themes such as sustainability, digital transformation, AI, automation,
circular economy and new revenue models. We connect these themes back to specific industry and
segment opportunities.

[Read More about Thematic and Disruption Research][51]
[Thematic and Disruption Research]

## Strategic Revenue Advisory

Our Strategic Revenue Advisory helps organizations make confident, evidence-driven decisions about
where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,
customer behaviour, competitive context, and financial modelling to build a revenue strategy that is
resilient, high-impact, and aligned with long-term growth opportunities.

Support for decisions on where to play, how to win and how fast to move. This includes portfolio
focus, market entry, pricing, partnership strategy and capital allocation grounded in evidence.

[Read More about Strategic Revenue Advisory][52]
[Strategic Revenue Advisory]

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

### From Insight to Implementation

#### Data Collection

Structured gathering of market, customer, financial and competitive data from primary and secondary
sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

Use of quantitative models and AI supported analysis to reveal patterns, stress points and leading
indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

## Ready to turn market uncertainty into revenue clarity

Our consultants are ready to support your next strategy cycle, investment decision or market entry
initiative with clear, evidence based insight.

[Connect with Our Experts][53]

Our consultants are ready to help craft a future-focused, resilient, and innovative packaging
strategy tailored to your needs.

Connect with us through [www.strategicrevenueinsights.com][54] to discover how we can support your
packaging vision and operationalize your ambitions into tangible market impact.

[LEARN MORE][64]

## Programs & Services

Adolescent Services

We provide current and former foster youth with individualized programing and support related to
successful transitions from systems of care to independence.

[Learn More][65]

Caregiver Supports Program

Essential services for caregivers - both licensed and unlicensed - who care for children placed by
the Department of Children, Youth, and Families (DCYF).

[Learn More][66]

Combined In-Home Services

Combined in-home services focuses on family preservation, education, and support services to
families whose children are at risk of removal due to abuse and/or neglect.

[Learn More][67]

Therapeutic Foster Network

Therapeutic Foster Network programs offer a variety of services to children and families, all of
which are designed to promote expedited and successful reunifications.

[Learn More][68]
